company.name: Mineral Resources Ltd
company.description: Mineral Resources Limited, together with subsidiaries, provides mining services in Australia, China, and internationally. It operates through Mining Services, Iron Ore, Lithium, Energy, and Other segments. The company offers mining services contractors, and trades in mining services; pit-to-ship solutions to the resources sectors; design and construction of mineral processing facilities; transport and logistics services comprising supply chain, road haulage, autonomous road train, and transshipping services; manufacturing of equipment and parts for the mining industry; rehabilitation services; and engineering and construction services. It also provides iron ore with the transformational Onslow Iron project in the West Pilbara region; produces and supplies battery-grade lithium products; develops and mines lithium from its mines that sells spodumene concentrate; and develops, mines, and exports iron ore. In addition, the company engages in exploration and drilling services for the energy sector; manganese projects and the Lucky Bay garnet mines; gas production; and energy solutions for natural gas to power operations; explores renewable energy sources, such as solar, wind, and geothermal; conventional gas and geothermal energy solutions; and power. Further, it provides crushing, processing, haulage, port materials handling, transhipping, mobile mining asset maintenance, camp and accommodation, and domestic air transportation services. Mineral Resources Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Osborne Park, Australia.

company.name: TELIX Pharmaceuticals Ltd
company.description: Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited, a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the development and commercialization of therapeutic and diagnostic radiopharmaceuticals. The company operates through three segments: Precision Medicine, Therapeutics, and Manufacturing Solutions. Its lead therapeutic product candidate is TLX591, a lutetium-labeled radio antibody-drug conjugate (rADC), which is in a Phase 3 clinical trial in patients with advanced prostate cancer. The company develops TLX250, an rADC for treating advanced metastatic kidney cancer; TLX101, a systemic therapy for the treatment of glioblastoma; TLX66, a product candidate for bone marrow conditioning for hematopoietic stem cell transplant conditioning; and Illuccix and Gozellix for the treatment of prostate cancer. The company is also developing TLX592, a prostate cancer therapy candidate for targeted alpha therapy based on its proprietary RADmAb-engineered antibody technology; TLX252 for the treatment of patients with advanced metastatic kidney cancer; TLX400, a bladder fibroblast activation protein for treating various tumors; TLX102, a large amino acid transporter-targeting small molecule-based alpha therapy candidate for the treatment of glioblastoma and multiple myeloma; TLX300 for treating soft tissue sarcoma; and TLX090, a bone-seeking agent for bone metastases and pain palliation. In addition, it is developing BiPASS, which is in Phase 3 clinical trial for prostate cancer diagnosis; AlFluor, a novel PET radiochemistry solution; TLX250-Px, a PET diagnostic imaging agent; and TLX101-Px, a radiolabeled amino acid PET agent. It operates in Australia, Belgium, Canada, the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. The company has strategic collaboration with University Hospital Essen. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in North Melbourne, Australia.
